violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: Observed food storage containers being washed in the high temperature dish machine. Final rinse of the high temperature dish machine was observed at 157f. Dish machine was observed not sanitizing
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC SET UP THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK TO SANITIZE DISHES. PIC STATES SHE WILL CALL FOR SERVICE. PIC SANITIZED ALL PREVIOUSLY WASHED DISHES IN THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. SERVICE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISH MACHINE. DISH MACHINE NEEDS TO BE SANITIZING AT 160f.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The hot water rinse of the high temperature dish washer was observed between 155f-159f.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. DISCONTINUE USING THE DISH MACHINE FOR SANITIZATION. MANUALLY SANITIZE ALL DISHES IN THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK. SOAK IN QUATERNARY AMMONIUM FOR 30-60 SECONDS AND ALLOW TO AIR DRY. PIC SET UP THE 3 COMPARTMENT SINK AND INSTRUCTED STAFF ON MANUAL SANITIZING PROCEDURES

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: precooked meatballs were observed at 120-135f
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED THE MEATBALLS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: On the cold rail of the cook line, liquid eggs in a squeeze bottle was observed between 51f-54f. Upon discussion, the cold rail was stocked 1 hour prior.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC MOVED THE LIQUID EGGS TO THE WALK IN.
